description: Structural storage slice for #768, stacked on #806: evolve existing messages UUID rows in place (retain ratings/trace FKs) with nullable legacy conversation_id for new shared messages; add source/account identity, author snapshot and timestamp; introduce transcripts with strategy/scope and associations with stable local sequence/provenance plus uniqueness and FK safeguards. No legacy row rewrite, no automatic hydration, no BO UI. Before implementation test preserved legacy rows/references, multi-transcript same message, constraint/idempotency and reversible safe schema changes without resetting populated DB. Reuse existing Message/Conversation schemas; new schema modules are Engine-owned persistence (local-only, no Action/tool). Mocks none: database integration/property tests with isolated state. Read Engine guide, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md and module docs. Update docs/services/engine.md. New-feature E2E remains behind zaq-emb.12; .15 owns backfill/cutover.

comments.text: 2026-09-26 Action reuse assessment BEFORE storage edit: operations affected = persist canonical message row, define transcript, attach one message to a transcript. Candidate existing Conversations.add_message/2 and Message.changeset/2 currently require conversation_id and trigger telemetry/title side effects; reusing that writer for passive/shared fanout would duplicate messages and leak side effects. Candidate ChannelHistoryResource.for/3 provides a coordinate only, not a storage writer. Decision: extend existing Message schema in place; local-only Ecto Transcript/TranscriptMessage schema and DDL (structural primitives, not executable Actions). .3.2 owns transactionally authorized writers/readers via existing Conversations context, never new agent tool. Schema contract: preserve legacy UUIDs and ratings/trace references; legacy writes unchanged; new canonical rows scoped by provider + account key + external id when available, transcript identity and permission coordinate explicit, association sequence unique and monotone to be allocated under lock in .3.2. Verify DB constraint/isolation and legacy read/regression tests, no external mocks, no E2E authored. Source catalog/Actions will be revisited for .3.2; no standalone agent/workflow execution for raw persistence, so no new Action.

title: [zaq-emb.3.1] Add canonical message and transcript association schema
